<title>riscv-unprivileged-20250508</title>
<section>Chapter 31. Cryptography Extensions: Scalar & Entropy Source Instructions, Version 1.0.1 > 31.4. Instructions > 31.4.45. unzip > Operation</section>
<previous>#### **Description**

This instruction scatters all of the odd and even bits of a source word into the high and low halves of a destination word. It is the inverse of the zip instruction. This instruction is available only on RV32.</previous>
<target>#### **Operation**

```
foreach (i from 0 to xlen/2-1) {
  X(rd)[i] = X(rs1)[2*i]
  X(rd)[i+xlen/2] = X(rs1)[2*i+1]
}
```</target>
<next>#### _Software Hint_

 _This instruction is useful for implementing the SHA3 cryptographic hash function on a 32-bit architecture, as it implements the bit-interleaving operation used to speed up the 64-bit rotations directly._</next>
